company_summary.one_line_business: We are a leading global provider of solar and energy technology solutions for utility-scale power plants. Founded in 2013 by our Chief Executive Officer, Dan Shugar, we pioneered and remain the global market leader in solar tracking systems. We now deliver an integrated suite of structural, electrical, and digital solutions across the full lifecycle of solar power plants, from design and construction through operations and maintenance. Our integrated solutions are designed to streamline project execution, increase energy yield and long-term reliability, and enhance customer return on investment (“ROI”).
